exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithful HD PAINTED GAME diffuse UV texture.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE native stored RGB edit target 256x128. Image2 is ONLY that identical whole source enlarged4x with nearest pixels, to expose the existing tiny paint pattern. Both are the same single canvas. Output ENTIRE same aspect 256:128 canvas and UV, same orientation, no margin/crop/padding/repacking/rotation/zoom. Original full selected alpha restored numerically after this edit.

Preserve the full wide source painting unchanged in layout: narrow dark left strip and oval shape, gray-black angular left and central panels with their exact old pale points, same black gap and source bottom silhouette. The small old brown crosshatched patch at lower-left MUST stay its original vague sampled grid: keep original painted cell counts and phase, do not design boot tread or hardware. The broad warm brown right field keeps its exact old diagonal and vertical diffuse folds, faint center line and dark bottom cutoff; soften sampling only, do not add new crease edges, shadows, weave or photographic grain. Targeted preservation: keep ALL original diffuse paint weak and soft exactly where source is weak. Do not introduce round metallic buttons, punched black holes, shiny raised frames, dense fine grain, cloth weave, pitting, additional folds or zigzag units. Existing pale points are vague old paint, not instructions to render hardware. Existing grayscale tiny lines keep their original count, endpoints and spacing. Flat color fields remain flat.

Only improve painted resolution inside the EXISTING shapes. Preserve original palette, matte or shiny material, low contrast and brush softness, relative local lights, all original black gaps/cutouts, and pattern count and scale. Do not redraw little marks into new symbols, add weave/thread/grain/pores/stitches, new folds, bright bevels or hardware. No photograph, new anatomy, new text or new objects. This must remain a faithful old painted game UV texture, no portrait or assembled garment.

Image3 is the SAME ENTIRE source enlarged4x with Lanczos sampling ONLY to demonstrate the original soft painted color transitions and weak marks. It adds no artwork. Use Image1 for precise source geometry/counts and Image2 for existing small mark phase; keep Image3 soft diffuse paint character. All input images represent ONE identical UV canvas. Do not turn low-resolution pixel steps into raised rims or buttons. Resolve existing brush paint gently, with no new crisp outlines or fine surface texture. The result should remain soft hand-painted game diffuse even at HD resolution.
